# Backpack (`equipment:backpack`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 2 gp | **Weight:** 5 lb.

A Backpack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot. It can also serve as a saddlebag.
